['Telef\u00f3nica Deutschland Holding AG.company_description: Telefónica Deutschland Holding AG, commonly known as Telefónica Germany, is a German telecommunications provider. It offers both mobile and landline services and is listed on the TecDAX. The company operates in the mobile communications sector and provides a range of products and services, including mobile and broadband internet. As of the end of 2021, Telefónica Deutschland Holding AG had approximately 15.4 million customer contracts, with 11.2 million for mobile services and 4.2 million for broadband internet.

['Wacker Chemie AG '].company_description: Wacker Chemie AG is a German multinational chemical company with a product range that includes silicone rubbers, polymer products, chemical materials, polysilicon, and wafers for the semiconductor industry. The company operates more than 25 production sites in Europe, Asia, and the Americas and sells its products in over 100 countries. Its corporate annual sales in 2015 were about 5.3 billion Euros, and it had approximately 16,972 employees at that time.
